description:
Save a FREE provider key the owner pasted to you into your brand's vault.
The key goes straight to the vault, which makes one small test call to the provider before saving;
if the provider refuses it, nothing is stored. NEVER repeat the key back, quote it, log it or put
it in a file — not even part of it. Tell the owner to delete the chat message that carried it.
Refused here, with the dashboard link instead: a paid key (kind other than free), a browser
sign-in (ChatGPT, Gemini …) and any provider that cannot be added. Phone checks happen on the
provider's page — give the link, never ask for the code.
Returns { added, integration_id, provider, checked, models_count, warning } — never the key.
Needs a key with the gate:vault:write scope, held by the brand owner.

api_key.description: The key exactly as pasted. Never echoed.

extra_fields.description: Other fields the provider's guide lists in extra_fields (e.g. account_id)

name: gate_add_key
